_doc: What each AMI action of Asterisk 22.11.0 returns, read from the C handler (source = handler definition): extra Response headers, list item / complete events, other events it triggers.

AGI.note: AsyncAGIExec published via stasis when the queued command runs (async).

AOCMessage.successMessage: AOC Message successfully queued on channel

AgentLogoff.note: AgentLogoff published via stasis when the agent actually logs out (async).

BridgeInfo.note: BridgeInfoComplete also carries the bridge snapshot headers (BridgeUniqueid, BridgeType, ...).

responseFields.name: Challenge
responseFields.note: random number; used as MD5 salt for Login AuthType=MD5

Challenge.note: No Message header. Error unless AuthType=MD5.

responseFields.name: Output
responseFields.note: repeated, one header per CLI output line

Command.note: Response is Success or Error per CLI result, both with Output lines. On temp-file errors Message differs and no Output.

ConfbridgeKick.note: Message: 'All participants kicked' if Channel=all, else 'User kicked'. ConfbridgeLeave when kicked users leave (async).

ConfbridgeList.note: ConfbridgeList items also carry channel snapshot headers.

ConfbridgeListRooms.note: No conferences: Response: Error 'No active conferences.'

ConfbridgeMute.note: ConfbridgeMute per affected user via stasis (async).

ConfbridgeUnmute.note: ConfbridgeUnmute per affected user via stasis (async).

ControlPlayback.note: astman_send_ack with NULL message: no Message header.

CoreShowChannelMap.note: Error 'Could not complete channel map' can follow the listack.

DAHDIShowChannels.note: Complete event carries Items twice (ListItems via list_complete_start + extra Items header).

DAHDIShowStatus.note: Complete event also has extra Items header.

DeviceStateList.note: Items are cached stasis messages rendered via stasis_message_to_ami.

DialplanExtensionRemove.note: Message is 'Removed the requested priority from the extension' if Priority given, else 'Removed the requested extension'.

Events.note: No Message header. With broken_events_action=yes, no reply at all on error or when mask equals 'all'.

ExtensionState.note: Message header written via astman_append after start_ack.

ExtensionStateList.note: Error 'No dialplan hints are available' when there are no hints.

FAXSession.note: FAXSession event built by the fax tech (res_fax_spandsp.c); omitted if building it fails.

FAXSessions.note: Listack uses EventList: Start (capital S). Complete has extra Total header.

responseFields.name: Templates-NNNNNN
responseFields.note: comma list of inherited templates, if any

responseFields.name: Line-NNNNNN-NNNNNN
responseFields.note: cat index, line index; value is name=value

GetConfig.note: No Message header. Bare line 'No categories found' (not a header) if Category given and nothing matched.

Hangup.note: Plain Channel: simple ack 'Channel Hungup'. Channel=/regex/: listack 'Channels hung up will follow' + items. See ast_manager_hangup_helper.

IAXnetstats.note: No Response header: raw space-separated netstats lines per call (ACN_FORMAT2), then a blank line.

IAXpeerlist.successMessage: IAX Peer status list will follow
IAXpeerlist.note: PeerEntry items have Channeltype: IAX, Mask/Port, no Description.

IAXpeers.note: PeerEntry items carry no ActionID (idtext left empty). Channeltype: IAX2.

JabberSend.note: Ack first, then a 2nd response: Response: Error 'Could not find Sender', or bare Response: Success/Error (no Message).

responseFields.name: <ActionName>
responseFields.note: one header per permitted action; value '<synopsis> (Priv: <perms>)'

ListCommands.note: No Message header. Header names are the action names themselves.

LocalOptimizeAway.successMessage: Queued channel to be optimized away

LoggerRotate.successMessage: Reloaded the logger and rotated log files

Login.note: Message 'Authentication accepted' or 'Already authenticated'. FullyBooted sent to session if it reads system events and core fully booted.

Logoff.note: Response is 'Goodbye' (not Success); session is closed after.

MWIDelete.note: astman_send_ack with NULL message: no Message header.

MWIUpdate.note: astman_send_ack with NULL message: no Message header.

MailboxCount.note: Message header written via astman_append after start_ack.

MailboxStatus.note: Message header written via astman_append after start_ack.

MeetmeList.note: No conferences at all: Response: Error 'No active conferences.'

MeetmeListRooms.note: No conferences: Response: Error 'No active conferences.'

MeetmeMute.note: Handler only sets admin flag; conference thread later publishes MeetmeMute (async).

MeetmeUnmute.note: Handler only clears admin flags; conference thread later publishes MeetmeMute Status: off (async).

responseFields.name: MixMonitorID
responseFields.note: Only when Options has i(var) and the var is non-empty

MixMonitor.note: Hand-written Response: Success, no Message. MixMonitorStart via stasis (async).

MixMonitorMute.note: Hand-written Response: Success with no Message. MixMonitorMute event via stasis (async).

responseFields.name: Version
responseFields.note: always empty; omitted if built with LOW_MEMORY

ModuleLoad.note: Message by LoadType: 'Module loaded.', 'Module unloaded.', 'Module unloaded and loaded.', 'Module reloaded.', 'All modules reloaded'.

MuteAudio.note: Hand-written Response: Success with no Message.

Originate.note: OriginateResponse (with ActionID) only when Async=true, raised as a broadcast call-class event. Sync mode blocks until answer/fail.

PJSIPHangup.note: ast_manager_hangup_helper: plain Channel gets ack 'Channel Hungup'; /regex/ gets listack 'Channels hung up will follow' + list.

PJSIPQualify.note: Qualify runs synchronously per AOR; ContactStatus events only follow if a contact status changes.

PJSIPRegister.note: Message: 'Reregistrations queued.' (*all), 'Reregistration sent', or 'Failed to queue unregistration' (still Success).

PJSIPSetMaintenance.note: Message: 'Maintenance mode enabled/disabled' [+ ' for all endpoints']. Broadcast event sent before ack, only if state changed.

PJSIPShowAors.successMessage: A listing of AORs follows, presented as AorList events
PJSIPShowAors.note: No AORs: Response: Error 'No AORs found'.

PJSIPShowAuths.successMessage: A listing of Auths follows, presented as AuthList events
PJSIPShowAuths.note: No auths: Response: Error 'No Auths found'.

PJSIPShowContacts.successMessage: A listing of Contacts follows, presented as ContactList events
PJSIPShowContacts.note: No contacts: Response: Error 'No Contacts found'.

PJSIPShowEndpoint.successMessage: Following are Events for each object associated with the Endpoint
PJSIPShowEndpoint.note: EndpointDetail first, then registered endpoint formatters. IdentifyDetail needs res_pjsip_endpoint_identifier_ip.

PJSIPShowEndpoints.successMessage: A listing of Endpoints follows, presented as EndpointList events
PJSIPShowEndpoints.note: No endpoints: Response: Error 'No endpoints found'. ListItems = endpoint count.

PJSIPShowRegistrationInboundContactStatu.successMessage: Following are ContactStatusEvents for each Inbound registration

PJSIPShowRegistrationsInbound.successMessage: Following are Events for each Inbound registration
PJSIPShowRegistrationsInbound.note: One InboundRegistrationDetail per AOR of each endpoint (AOR shared by endpoints repeats).

PJSIPShowRegistrationsOutbound.successMessage: Following are Events for each Outbound registration
PJSIPShowRegistrationsOutbound.note: AuthDetail per outbound auth follows each registration. Complete has extra Registered/NotRegistered headers.

PJSIPShowResourceLists.successMessage: A listing of resource lists follows, presented as ResourceListDetail events
PJSIPShowResourceLists.note: No lists: Response: Error 'No resource lists found'.

PJSIPShowSubscriptionsInbound.successMessage: Following are Events for each inbound Subscription

PJSIPShowSubscriptionsOutbound.successMessage: Following are Events for each outbound Subscription

PJSIPUnregister.note: Message: 'Unregistrations queued.' (*all), 'Unregistration sent', or 'Failed to queue unregistration' (still Success).

PRIDebugFileSet.successMessage: PRI debug output will now be sent to requested file.
PRIDebugFileSet.note: Only with HAVE_PRI. Missing File: error sent without return, so a second error follows.

PRIDebugFileUnset.successMessage: PRI Debug output to file disabled

PRIDebugSet.successMessage: Debug level set for requested span
PRIDebugSet.note: Only with HAVE_PRI. Invalid span error is hand-written Response: Error.

PRIShowSpans.note: Only with HAVE_PRI. Items built by sig_pri_ami_show_spans (sig_pri.c). Complete event has extra Items header.

Park.note: Message text ends with a stray \n. ParkedCall published via stasis (async).

ParkedCalls.note: Complete has extra Total header. Unknown ParkingLot: Response: Error.

PresenceState.note: When a presence message exists, a 2nd deprecated 'Message: <text>' header is also sent before PresenceMessage.

PresenceStateList.note: Items are cached stasis messages rendered via stasis_message_to_ami.

QueueChangePriorityCaller.successMessage: Priority change for caller on queue

QueueMemberRingInUse.note: Async event name is spelled QueueMemberRinginuse.

QueuePause.note: Message: 'Interface paused successfully' or 'Interface unpaused successfully' per Paused. QueueMemberPause per affected member.

responseFields.name: RuleList
responseFields.note: Repeated once per matching rule list

responseFields.name: Rule
responseFields.note: Repeated; follows its RuleList; format time,max,min

QueueRule.note: Hand-written Response: Success, no Message. RuleList/Rule headers repeat per list. Ends with two blank lines.

Redirect.note: Message 'Redirect successful' (single) or 'Dual Redirect successful' (with ExtraChannel).

ShowDialPlan.note: Complete adds ListExtensions/ListPriorities/ListContexts. Error may follow listack if Context/Extension not found after items were sent.

SorceryMemoryCacheExpire.successMessage: All objects were expired from the cache
SorceryMemoryCacheExpire.note: Message text ends with a stray \n.

SorceryMemoryCacheExpireObject.successMessage: The provided object was expired from the cache
SorceryMemoryCacheExpireObject.note: Message text ends with a stray \n.

SorceryMemoryCachePopulate.successMessage: Cache has been expired and populated
SorceryMemoryCachePopulate.note: Message text ends with a stray \n.

SorceryMemoryCacheStale.successMessage: All objects were marked as stale in the cache
SorceryMemoryCacheStale.note: Message text ends with a stray \n.

SorceryMemoryCacheStaleObject.successMessage: The provided object was marked as stale in the cache
SorceryMemoryCacheStaleObject.note: Message text ends with a stray \n.

Status.note: StatusComplete also carries Items: <count> (duplicate of ListItems).

StopMixMonitor.note: Hand-written Response: Success with no Message. MixMonitorStop via stasis (async).

UpdateConfig.note: Ack sent with no Message header. Reload happens after the ack.

UserEvent.note: UserEvent is broadcast (EVENT_FLAG_USER) after the ack, carrying the request headers except Action/UserEvent.

VoicemailBoxSummary.note: Unknown user: plain ack 'There is no voicemail user matching the given user.' with no list.

VoicemailForward.note: Failure is also Response: Success, Message 'Message forward failed\n'. Message values end with a stray \n.

VoicemailMove.note: Failure is also Response: Success, Message 'Message move failed\n'. Message values end with a stray \n.

VoicemailRemove.note: Failure is also Response: Success, Message 'Message remove failed\n'. Message values end with a stray \n.

VoicemailUserStatus.note: Unknown user: plain ack 'There is no voicemail user of the given info.' with no list.

VoicemailUsersList.note: No users: plain ack 'There are no voicemail users currently defined.' with no list.

WaitEvent.note: Blocks until an event/timeout, then Success, any queued events of any type, then WaitEventComplete (no EventList/ListItems).
